prompt:
Edit the attached educational crane wire-rope terminal illustration into a highly accurate professional 3D technical textbook figure, Japanese typography, white background, restrained navy titles, gray steel, small red structural highlights. Portrait aspect 5:6, roughly 1500x1800. SIX roomy panels in TWO columns and THREE rows, clear blank gutters, no crowded text, labels about 60px at 1500width to remain legible on phone. Main heading "ワイヤロープの末端処理".
Panel 1 label "ソケット止め": poured socket termination, sectional steel socket showing separated individual wires splayed inside and embedded in reddish solidified alloy, wire-rope continuing out below.
Panel 2 label "圧縮止め": eye with thimble and a single smooth metal ferrule holding the folded rope together, realistic cylindrical sleeve.
Panel 3 label "アイスプライス": technically correct hand-spliced wire rope eye with thimble, SHOW SEVERAL SEPARATE THIN STRANDS of the dead end being tucked alternately into the lay grooves of the standing rope across an extended tapered splice, one loose strand at the lower side to clarify tucking. It is NOT a knot, NOT a braid of whole thick rope, no bulky repeated X loops, no metal ferrule. Show the single continuous rope eye and the thinner tucked strands. Small label "ストランドを編み込む" below.
Panel 4 label "クリップ止め": thimble eye with three U-bolt clips installed consistently, saddles all on the live standing long side (right), rounded U bolts all on dead short side (left).
Panel 5 label "くさび止め": open-front sectional wedge socket, rope enters from left top, loops around bottom of tapered wedge inside socket and dead tail exits right down; overall wedge retaining housing realistic. Do NOT join dead tail to live side. Show wedge distinctly.
Panel 6 label "クリップの向き": large close-up ONE U-bolt clip correctly joining two parallel wire ropes. Left rope short tail "端末側", right rope long standing part "本体側". Rounded U-bolt contacts left short rope, saddle contacts right long rope. Use short thin leader lines for two labels "Uボルト → 端末側" and "サドル → 本体側", avoid arrows over artwork. Main mnemonic below "サドルは本体側へ".
Maintain realistic cutaway mechanical quality, consistent lighting, orthographic-like camera, no unnecessary colors, no instruction text, no accuracy disclaimer, no efficiency percentages, no external logo. Wide margins and large straightforward labels. Reference image provides overall subject only; rebuild layout and CORRECT the eye splice as described.
